note: Grammar allow-list. Every entry records the licence of the TextMate grammar Shiki ships for it, read from the grammar's upstream source (tm-grammars 1.32.3, the version @shikijs/langs 4.4.3 is built from; licenceEvidence where tm-grammars recorded none). Only MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0, BSD, MPL-2.0 and the permissive TextMate bundle licence may be listed. Every grammar Shiki ships is listed but those in forbiddenGrammars (copyleft: GPL-3.0 ada, gnuplot, nginx, org, racket; LGPL-3.0 ahk2) and unlicensedGrammars (no licence found upstream: dax, glsl, tcl), which must never be added. A listed grammar that embeds one of them (C++, Ruby and others embed GLSL) loads without it: the build stubs its module (apps/desktop/vite.config.ts) and core leaves it out at run time. scripts/gate-licences.mjs fails if any entry is missing a licence or carries a copyleft one; scripts/gate-highlight-bundle.mjs fails if dist holds a grammar off the list.
